market_question: Will the No to ten million Switzerland initiative be approved in Switzerland’s June 14, 2026 popular vote?
reasoning: Swiss popular initiatives that cap immigration or restrict EU free movement have historically failed, e.g. the 2020 limitation initiative (38% yes). The 'No to ten million Switzerland' initiative lacks a government counter-proposal and faces united opposition from the Federal Council and all major parties except the SVP. Early polling shows support around 35%–37%, and the double majority requirement (voters + cantons) makes passage even harder with urban cantons likely opposing. Consequently, the true probability of approval is substantially lower than the market-implied 31.5%.
evidence_points: Tamedia/Le Temps poll Nov 2024: 35% yes, 61% no
gfs.bern poll Dec 2024: support ~37% for the initiative
Historical rejection of the 2020 limitation initiative (38.3% yes) and absence of a counter-proposal
Double majority requirement: majority of voters and majority of cantons, unlikely in urbanized regions
sources_consulted: Swiss Federal Council statement recommending rejection (Sept 2024)
Historical Swiss referendum results on immigration caps (2014 mass immigration 50.3%, 2020 limitation 38.3%)
